verdict.rationale: CUDA Toolkit docs confirm the general software stack (CUDA, Nsight tools) that underlies frameworks like PyTorch, and community evidence shows a production LLM workload (Llama 405B) running on H200 SXM, implying real-world framework support. However, there is no explicit NVIDIA documentation or support matrix naming PyTorch or other mainstream ML frameworks as officially validated on H200.  missing for 10: official PyTorch/TensorFlow support matrix, explicit framework version compatibility docs, first-party benchmark or install guide referencing PyTorch on H200.
